Its complete prerequisite list is recorded in the item manifest; active Tong HTML and Arovas Chapter 2 provide independent context.

This is an adopted, regime-limited piston coupling, not a derivation: the local statement specifies piston area, outward displacement, force sign, p_mech=p_c, and delta W_on=-p_c dV. Its physical scope and formulation are preserved in the item and postulate contract.

The local argument applies the recorded scalar M3 interface conditionally at the selected point, then differentiates S_c(U(s,V,n),V,n)=s and uses the chain rule and intensity definitions to derive U_s=T, U_V=-p, and U_nj=mu_j. The registered M3 batch-4 draft supplies only a C1 graph; the local proof derives C2 regularity, but readiness remains escalated pending independent proof review.

The local proof constructs bilateral energy, volume, and species exchange curves, applies the two-sided difference-quotient test at the attained maximum, and substitutes S_U=1/T, S_V=p/T, and S_n=-mu/T. Retained coordinates and one-sided boundaries yield no equality; all hypotheses and direct dependencies remain explicit.

The local proof states the convex affine slice and stationarity assumptions, applies the planned M2 interface conditionally, proves strict-concavity uniqueness by a midpoint contradiction, and derives the fixed-tag Hessian null direction only under extra same-tag homogeneity. The current M2 carrier has a different local-minimum interface, so the planned global-max/Hessian input remains conditional and escalated; the tagged-scaling mismatch is also escalated.

The local definition names the natural variables, fixed amounts, C1 inverse-chart requirement, units, and no-sign/no-finiteness claims outside valid charts. Its direct dependencies are retained in the item and manifest.
